data.body: Gerrit change 1842: LLM-Review +1. Verified CI exposed one deterministic failure across Python 3.11/3.12/3.13: `test_canonical_outbound_equivalence.py::test_description_change_emits_description` expects the legacy plain-wire payload `{description: "LOCAL"}`, while the newly enabled Cloud codec correctly emits ADF-canonical Markdown `{description: "LOCAL\n"}`. Local reproduction fails under project config and passes with `REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=off`. Recommended remediation is to isolate this legacy golden-equivalence module from project operational config by explicitly setting the cutover off in its backend fixture, rather than changing production behavior or updating the golden to depend on the project setting. Awaiting operator approval because this expands the config-only ticket into a test-file change.
